cost_usd.note: exploratory cluster bootstrap; null interval means descriptive only

latency_s.note: exploratory cluster bootstrap; null interval means descriptive only

bootstrap_by_family.note: descriptive only: the interval collapsed to a point over 18 families (no variation in the paired difference)

mcnemar.assumption: pairs are independent; violated when several cases share a family

sensitivity_excluding_infra_failures.rule: exclude a pair when either side failed on Billing or model-API infrastructure (5xx, connection, timeout, rate limit). Budget exhaustion, protocol repairs and software errors are never excluded.
